categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Matches the Tests label and adds stream operator utilities in src/test/util/common.{h,cpp} along with updating assertion macros across 17 unit test files.
categories.rationale: Improves unit test failure diagnostics by providing stream insertion operators for custom types so failed checks display mismatched values. Per the PR description, 'boost can use this as a debug output when a check fails' and the display strings also support test framework modernization in #35713.
